en.name: Star jump
en.subtitle: Teacher review
steps: Show a star shape with arms and legs apart in the air. Review the full attempt.
Face the camera and keep your whole movement in view.
en.focus: Review with your teacher. No automatic technique score is assigned.

zh-Hant.name: 星形跳
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師檢視
steps: 在空中張開雙臂及雙腿，展示星形姿勢，檢視完整一次動作。
面向鏡頭，讓整個動作保持在畫面內。
zh-Hant.focus: 與老師一同檢視，不提供自動技術評分。
